diagnosis.initial_result: GPI and IPI matched after startup, but FCPI diverged intermittently by as much as about 24.89 points.
diagnosis.root_cause: The Python mirror used pandas fixed-bar rolling windows. Pine ta.sma/ta.stdev ignore na source observations and count the latest length valid observations. Real-yield ROC becomes na when its lagged denominator is zero; the old Python code therefore poisoned the momentum Z-score for 252 bars while Pine did not.
diagnosis.fix: Use Pine-compatible rolling mean and biased standard deviation over the latest non-na observations.

interpretation: This establishes engineering parity for the frozen V6.6 default market-only path when Python is fed the same TradingView source rows.
It does not validate optional macro, official-FCI, T5YIE, industrial-metals, or KRE paths.
It does not establish predictive value, regime quality, trading profitability, or public-feed parity.
The first 355 logged rows are excluded because the log starts in 2007 while the original Pine script can use earlier chart history.
